import sys
import math

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n_value = int(input_data[0])
    k_value = int(input_data[1])
    x_values = list(map(int, input_data[2:2 + k_value]))
    freq_arr = [0] * 10
    for x in x_values:
        freq_arr[x] = 1
    result = [1]
    half_power = n_value // 2
    MOD = 998244353

    def multiply_modulo(a, b, m):
        length_needed = len(a) + len(b) - 1
        n_size = 1 << (length_needed - 1).bit_length()

        re_a = [0.0] * n_size
        im_a = [0.0] * n_size
        for i in range(len(a)):
            x_coord = a[i] % m
            re_a[i] = x_coord & ((1 << 15) - 1)
            im_a[i] = x_coord >> 15

        perform_fft(re_a, im_a, False)

        re_b = [0.0] * n_size
        im_b = [0.0] * n_size
        for i in range(len(b)):
            x_coord = b[i] % m
            re_b[i] = x_coord & ((1 << 15) - 1)
            im_b[i] = x_coord >> 15

        perform_fft(re_b, im_b, False)

        re_a2 = [0.0] * n_size
        im_a2 = [0.0] * n_size
        re_b2 = [0.0] * n_size
        im_b2 = [0.0] * n_size

        for i in range(n_size):
            j = (n_size - i) & (n_size - 1)
            a1r = (re_a[i] + re_a[j]) / 2
            a1i = (im_a[i] - im_a[j]) / 2
            a2r = (im_a[i] + im_a[j]) / 2
            a2i = (re_a[j] - re_a[i]) / 2
            b1r = (re_b[i] + re_b[j]) / 2
            b1i = (im_b[i] - im_b[j]) / 2
            b2r = (im_b[i] + im_b[j]) / 2
            b2i = (re_b[j] - re_b[i]) / 2

            re_a2[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
            im_a2[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
            re_b2[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
            im_b2[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r

        perform_fft(re_a2, im_a2, True)
        perform_fft(re_b2, im_b2, True)

        res_arr = [0] * length_needed
        for i in range(length_needed):
            aa = round(re_a2[i])
            bb = round(re_b2[i])
            cc = round(im_a2[i])
            res_arr[i] = int((aa + (bb << 15) + (cc << 30)) % m)
        return res_arr

    def perform_fft(re, im, invert):
        n = len(re)
        shift_calc = 32 - (n.bit_length() - 1)
        for i in range(1, n):
            j = int('{:b}'.format(i << shift_calc)[::-1], 2)
            if i < j:
                re[i], re[j] = re[j], re[i]
                im[i], im[j] = im[j], im[i]

        length = 2
        while length <= n:
            half_len = length // 2
            w_angle = 2 * math.pi / length * (-1 if invert else 1)
            w_re = math.cos(w_angle)
            w_im = math.sin(w_angle)
            for i in range(0, n, length):
                w_curr_re = 1.0
                w_curr_im = 0.0
                for j in range(half_len):
                    u_re = re[i + j]
                    u_im = im[i + j]
                    v_re = re[i + j + half_len] * w_curr_re - im[i + j + half_len] * w_curr_im
                    v_im = re[i + j + half_len] * w_curr_im + im[i + j + half_len] * w_curr_re
                    re[i + j] = u_re + v_re
                    im[i + j] = u_im + v_im
                    re[i + j + half_len] = u_re - v_re
                    im[i + j + half_len] = u_im - v_im
                    temp_re = w_curr_re * w_re - w_curr_im * w_im
                    w_curr_im = w_curr_re * w_im + w_curr_im * w_re
                    w_curr_re = temp_re
            length <<= 1

        if invert:
            for i in range(n):
                re[i] /= n
                im[i] /= n

    while half_power > 0:
        if (half_power & 1) == 1:
            result = multiply_modulo(result, freq_arr, MOD)
        freq_arr = multiply_modulo(freq_arr, freq_arr, MOD)
        half_power >>= 1

    total_res = 0
    for val in result:
        total_res = (total_res + val * val) % MOD

    print(total_res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
